data_and_splits.evaluation_folds: reuse exact chronological outer folds in reports/btc_preopen/policy_study.json
data_and_splits.history_for_fit: all eligible earlier opportunities with labels available before fold refit
data_and_splits.prediction_source: candidate_platt column in frozen opportunity cache

calibration.inner_validation: frozen preceding chronological selection block; train labels must be available before validation start

bootstrap.insufficient_history_fallback: use candidate_platt as point probability; disable robust Kelly for that fold

scenario_model.dependent_model: AR(1) Gaussian copula; lag-one correlation estimated from prior candidate_platt standardized residuals for adjacent 5-minute markets and shrunk by n/(n+200)
scenario_model.independent_control: same marginal probabilities and latent bank with identity correlation
scenario_model.scenario_horizon: joint settlement of all currently open positions and the proposed position
scenario_model.pending_position_payoffs: net shares times binary market outcome; cash released only at existing settlement release timestamp
scenario_model.wealth_reference: cash plus gross cost basis of open positions, fixed before evaluating each action
scenario_model.locked_due_funds: included once as pending-position terminal payouts; not available as current purchase cash

drk.objective: maximize worst-case expected terminal log wealth over the Cartesian product of bootstrap marginal probability intervals, with the common copula scenario dependence and equal scenario weights fixed
drk.uncertainty_set: each open/proposed position win probability lies in its fold-specific bootstrap 5th-95th percentile interval; monotone log wealth makes the lower endpoint worst case

rck.existing_portfolio_breach: record breach and prohibit additional purchases until the unconstrained/no-addition portfolio satisfies the local constraint
rck.interpretation: local portfolio risk constraint; not a multi-period maximum-drawdown guarantee

comparison_roles.point_kelly_btc_market: uses point-calibrated market-aware probabilities and the same dependent terminal scenarios as RCK; also serves as the no-risk-constraint portfolio Kelly control
comparison_roles.portfolio_kelly_independent: same point-calibrated probabilities with independent outcomes and no power constraint

sizing.gross_amount_grid_for_search_usd: continuous bounded scalar optimization up to $20, then round down to cents
sizing.post_rounding: recompute exact fee, minima, feasibility, objective, and RCK constraint; step down by one cent if needed

finite_budget.os_status: hold-to-resolution control only; trained exit policy excluded because local cache stops at market_start+5s
